tools.title: MailBoox
tools.subtitle: Lend books to your neighbours
tools.description:
## Overview

A neighbourhood library. List the books on your shelf, lend them to people nearby through your mailbox, and keep track of every handoff and return.

## Features

- Browse everyone's shelves, search by title or author, and sort by distance
- Ask to borrow; the owner accepts, then hands it over in person or leaves it in a mailbox with a note
- The borrower confirms pickup, marks it returned, and the owner confirms or says it hasn't arrived
- Approximate location (rounded to about 1 km) is visible to the group; exact addresses are shared encrypted, only with the other person in a loan
- Moss notifications for requests, handoffs and returns, including ones that arrived while you were offline
- Books are Weave assets: link them from other Tools and find them in group search

## Status

Early release for Moss 0.16 (Holochain 0.7). Source: https://github.com/matthewjosef/mailboox

versions.changelog: First release for Moss 0.16 / Holochain 0.7: shared neighbourhood library, borrow requests, mailbox handoff and pickup, returns with confirm or "not received" notes, approximate locations with distances, and exact addresses shared encrypted with the other party only.

Scan books with your camera: photograph a shelf or a single book, and a vision model running locally in Ollama reads the titles (photos never leave your computer). Suggestions are matched on Open Library and Google Books, then reviewed as a list with an Add / Skip toggle per book and Add all, or one card at a time with keyboard shortcuts and undo. Every suggestion can be edited or matched to a different edition, and books already on your shelf are set aside.

Fixes adding scanned books inside Moss: "Add all" and adding books one at a time failed with a DataCloneError, because the suggestions were sent to Moss as reactive state rather than plain data. All zome calls now send plain data.

Errors when adding scanned books now appear right next to the Add buttons, and every failed zome call is logged to the console as [MailBoox] <function> failed. The app version is shown at the bottom of each page.

Scanning full shelves no longer crashes the reader with GGML_ASSERT(a->ne[2] * 4 == b->ne[0]): the request now gives the model a 12k-token context (a shelf photo alone uses about 2,600 of Ollama's default 4,096) and caps the answer length. If one photo still fails, the books from the other photos are kept and the failed photo is named.
